title: Variables
summary: Variables store values in a program so you can reuse or change them later without rewriting the value everywhere.
sample_question: What is a variable and why is it useful?

title: Loops
summary: Loops let you repeat an action multiple times, either a fixed number of times or until a condition changes.
sample_question: Explain the difference between a for loop and a while loop.

title: HTML Basics
summary: HTML (HyperText Markup Language) is the standard language used to structure content on web pages using elements like headings, paragraphs, links, and images.
sample_question: What is HTML and what kinds of things can you define with it on a web page?

title: HTML Page Structure
summary: A basic HTML page usually includes a doctype, an html element, a head section for metadata, and a body section that holds the visible content.
sample_question: Describe the main parts of a basic HTML page structure.

title: CSS Basics
summary: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style and layout HTML elements, controlling things like colors, fonts, spacing, and positioning.
sample_question: What is CSS and why do we use it alongside HTML?

title: CSS Selectors
summary: CSS selectors are patterns used to choose which HTML elements a style rule applies to, such as by tag name, class, id, or more complex combinations.
sample_question: What is a CSS selector? Give an example of when you might use a class selector.
